ownershipCoverage.rule: Main players are those projected above 0 points who are not listed out; a source is used when the players it names hold at least 80% of their total projected points.

recipes.projection: Blended projection = weighted mean of Sleeper app x1, FantasyPros x1, CBS Sports x1, ESPN fantasy x1, DraftKings points converted from each source's own stat lines. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. A player no ticked source covers has no projection: it is left blank, flagged "no projection" (0 when the injury report lists him out, on IR, doubtful or suspended); his DraftKings average per game never stands in.
recipes.scoring: DraftKings scoring from stat lines; 100/300-yard bonuses paid as 3 x probability from a lognormal (cv rush 0.55, rec 0.55, pass 0.30); DST points-allowed from a normal around the opponent's implied total (SD 9.5, shutout rate unvalidated)

injury.comment: Jefferson caught nine of 13 targets for 74 yards in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
injury.longComment: In Kirk Cousins' return to the Vikings, Jefferson led the team in catches, targets and receiving yards, although Myles Price and Gavin Bartholomew were on the other end of the QB's two touchdown passes. The nine grabs and 13 targets were season highs for Jefferson, while the yardage total was his best showing since Week 5. Despite a disappointing 40-467-4 line on 64 targets through eight games, the star wideout's outlook for the rest of the year is pointed up heading into a Week 11 clash with the 49ers.

injury.comment: Cousins completed 21 of 31 passes for 207 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers. He added 11 rushing yards on three carries.
injury.longComment: Brought back to Minnesota at the trade deadline to stabilize the offense, Cousins did exactly that, connecting with Myles Price for a 38-yard TD in the first quarter and Gavin Bartholomew on a 20-yard score in the fourth while guiding Justin Jefferson to season highs in catches and targets. The Vikings' passing game didn't need to over-extend itself, however, as the defense sacked Jordan Love eight times in another dominant performance. Cousins may need to find another gear in Week 11 against the 49ers, but he'll have another week of practice to re-familiarize himself with Kevin O'Connell's scheme first.

injury.comment: Evans (Achilles), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City, is expected to be active and is likely to avoid a strict "pitch count," though the 49ers plan to "be smart" with his workload, Jay Glazer reported on "Fox NFL Sunday."
injury.longComment: Evans has been sidelined for the 49ers' previous three contests, but he appears on track to return after logging limited practices Thursday and Friday. Glazer's report suggests that the 49ers plan on giving him meaningful work right off the bat, though Evans may not quite reach the standard snap share he's handled in competitive games when fully healthy this season. Whatever the case, Evans' impending return to action in any capacity should be a boon for quarterback Brock Purdy and the 49ers' passing game.

injury.comment: Jones carried the ball 11 times for 47 yards and a touchdown and caught his only target for eight yards in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
injury.longComment: Jordan Mason led the Vikings with 59 rushing yards, but Jones had the more productive afternoon as he scored his first TD since Week 5 on a one-yard plunge in the second quarter. Jones' upside will remain limited while working in a timeshare with Mason, but he's still got some utility heading into a Week 11 clash with the 49ers.

injury.comment: Mason carried the ball 16 times for 59 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
injury.longComment: The fifth-year RB led the Vikings in rushing yards, but Aaron Jones was the more productive player in the backfield, gaining 55 scrimmage yards on 12 touches and scoring on a one-yard plunge in the second quarter. Mason has yet to get into the end zone in four games since returning from a thumb injury, piecing together 182 rushing yards on 4.0 yards per carry while working in a timeshare with Jones. He could break that drought in Week 11 in a potential revenge game against the 49ers.

injury.comment: Allen brought in five of seven targets for 61 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Allen looked rejuvenated in his 49ers debut after coming over from the Colts at the deadline, finishing third in receptions and receiving yards and second in targets for his new squad in the wild win. Allen and Brock Purdy seemed to have instant chemistry despite having practiced on only three occasions coming into the contest, and the veteran receiver's production should have a good chance of spiking further down the stretch of the regular season.

injury.comment: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that Addison underwent thumb surgery earlier this week and won't be placed on injured reserve, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.
injury.longComment: Thus, the Vikings are expecting Addison to recover fully before the four games required of an IR stint, but in any case he will miss some time due to the thumb injury he suffered in practice last Friday and sidelined him this past Sunday at Green Bay. With Addison out of the lineup, Minnesota will be relying on Justin Jefferson, Jauan Jennings (calf), Myles Price, Tai Felton and Jeshaun Jones at wide receiver.

injury.comment: Murray (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday night's game against the 49ers.
injury.longComment: The quarterback lost his job to Kirk Cousins and will continue to manage a hamstring injury. Murray's availability will only matter moving forward if something happens to Cousins, either performance or injury related. Carson Wentz and Max Brosmer remain on the 53-man roster as backup options.

injury.comment: Wentz (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game at Green Bay, but Kirk Cousins will be Minnesota's starting quarterback.
injury.longComment: Kyler Murray (hamstring) is out for another week but may eventually replace Wentz as the No. 2 quarterback. Wentz's miserable performance against the Bills last week likely was a factor in the Vikings trading for Cousins.

injury.comment: Jones (illness) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City.
injury.longComment: Jones put together an LP-DNP-LP practice log while working through an illness, which puts him in jeopardy of not being available for Sunday's contest. If Jones is inactive, then Kurtis Rourke would operate as the 49ers' backup to Brock Purdy,

injury.comment: Hockenson (wrist) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday night's game against the 49ers.
injury.longComment: After sitting out last Sunday against Green Bay and then logging limited practices Wednesday and Thursday, Hockenson is ready to return against San Francisco in a potential playoff preview. His lack of a designation puts Minnesota's top tight end in position to reclaim his usual role in the passing game that now has Kirk Cousins at quarterback. Hockenson is a TE1 for fantasy purposes.

injury.comment: Reichard made all three of his field-goal attempts and all three PATs in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers on Sunday.
injury.longComment: All three of Reichard's field goals came from fewer than 40 yards out in the contest. The return of Kirk Cousins allowed Minnesota's offense to surge to its highest touchdown total since Week 1, the team's first bout against the Packers. Reichard is now 23-for-25 on field-goal attempts and remains perfect at 13-for-13 on PATs over nine regular-season games in 2026.

injury.comment: Pineiro made his only field-goal attempt and went 5-for-5 on PATs during Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys.
injury.longComment: Pineiro made his only field-goal try from 28 yards in the second quarter. The kicker has now gone eight straight games without making multiple field goals, and his next chance to snap that streak will come in Week 11 against the Vikings' impressive defense.

injury.comment: Watkins caught two passes for 49 yards on three targets in Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys.
injury.longComment: With Deebo Samuel still working his way back to 100 percent off his hamstring injury, Keenan Allen being eased in after his acquisition from the Colts and Mike Evans (Achilles) remaining inactive, Watkins' 44 snaps led San Francisco's wideouts. However, his three targets were a distant fourth on the team and represented just a 10.7 percent share. Allen will likely play more moving forward, and Evans is expected back in the bear future. Watkins doesn't have much fantasy appeal as an ancillary option.

injury.comment: Jennings (calf) practiced in full Wednesday.
injury.longComment: Jennings sat out the last two games due to a calf injury, but his return to all activity Wednesday gives the Vikings' receiving corps a boost after Jordan Addison was lost for at least a few weeks due to a broken thumb that required surgery. As for Jennings, he'll have a prime opportunity to work opposite No. 1 WR Justin Jefferson as he looks to build upon his 6-54-0 line on 10 targets in his six appearances this season.

injury.comment: Price is set for an increase in offensive workload with Jordan Addison (thumb) sidelined, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.
injury.longComment: Price reeled in a season-high four passes for 49 yards and a score during Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers. The wideout was operating in a more prominent offensive role for the second week in a row with Jauan Jennings (calf) sidelined, and fellow wide receiver Jordan Addison (thumb) was unable to play as well. Addison now is expected to undergo thumb surgery, opening the door for Price to operate in an elevated position in Minnesota's offense for the time being.

injury.comment: Felton is on track to operate in a more prominent role in Week 11 versus the 49ers, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.
injury.longComment: Felton drew a start in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers, reeling in a season-high three of five targets for 33 yards over 56 offensive snaps. The wide receiver stepped into a starting role as a result of Jordan Addison (thumb) and Jauan Jennings (calf) being sidelined, and Addison is now reportedly set to undergo surgery to address his injury, opening the door for more opportunities for Felton moving forward.

injury.comment: Bartholomew should revert to a backup role with T.J. Hockenson returning from a wrist injury for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.
injury.longComment: Bartholomew was targeted four times in Week 10 for three catches, 36 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers. The tight end received more than one target in only one other game this season, Week 5, when Hockenson went down after two offensive snaps. While Bartholomew has proven himself a red-zone threat, Hockenson should return to seeing most of the tight end volume in Sunday's contest.

injury.comment: Robinson played 21 of 65 offensive snaps (32.3 percent) but didn't show up on the box score otherwise during the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Robinson's snap count was fourth-most among San Francisco's wide receivers, but his role in the offense shrunk due to the return of Deebo Samuel and the acquisition of Keenan Allen at the Nov. 10 trade deadline. Brandin Cooks (coach's decision) was a healthy scratch for Week 10, and Robinson could join the former on the sidelines for Week 11 against the Vikings on Nov. 22, if veteran wide receiver Mike Evans (Achilles) is cleared to return for that contest.

injury.comment: Dallas caught his only target for a two-yard gain in Monday's Week 9 loss to the Bills.
injury.longComment: Dallas notched just eight offensive snaps but also contributed 19 snaps on special teams. The veteran running back went without a carry for the fourth time over Minnesota's past five games, indicating his lack of a role in the running game. Overall this season, Dallas has been a very small part of the Vikings' offense, recording four carries for 14 yards and five catches for 36 yards (on five targets) through eight contests.

injury.comment: Cowing did not draw any targets during Sunday's 46-40 win at Dallas.
injury.longComment: Cowing was also sent back to receive two punts in Week 10, making a fair catch on one and allowing the other to go into the endzone for a touchback. He has now drawn just one target over the two games following his three-catch performance in Week 7, and his role in the 49ers' offense figures to shrink even further once veteran Mike Evans returns from Achilles tendinitis, which could happen as soon as Sunday versus Minnesota.

injury.comment: James (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City.
injury.longComment: James' practice reps were limited both Thursday and Friday due to a calf injury. He was limited to kickoff return duties against the Cowboys in Week 10, and that role could be taken over by Deebo Samuel and/or Jacob Cowing if James is unable to play Sunday.

injury.comment: Knee
Knee - PCL
Jones (shoulder) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the 49ers in Mexico City.
injury.longComment: Jones -- who was managing a shoulder injury during Week 11 prep -- was a full participant in Friday's session, which was enough for him to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's contest. He was signed to the Vikings' 53-man roster Wednesday to give the team more depth at wide receiver while Jordan Addison recovers from a thumb injury. Jones figures to be limited to a rotational role on offense while serving as a contributor on special teams.

injury.comment: Kirk announced Wednesday via his personal Instagram account that he recently underwent meniscus surgery.
injury.longComment: After he had missed the 49ers' first six games of the season while recovering from a calf injury, Kirk landed on injured reserve for the second time this season back on Nov. 7 due to a right knee injury sustained in his team debut Week 7 in Atlanta. Since Kirk didn't specify whether he required a partial meniscectomy or a meniscus repair, his exact recovery timeline isn't known. Regardless, he'll have to miss at least two more games while he's on IR.

injury.comment: Stribling (ankle) was doing some work on the side at Wednesday's practice, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.
injury.longComment: This is the first time Stribling has participated in on-field work since suffering a significant ankle injury in the Week 1 win over the Rams. The expectation has been that the rookie could be back by December, so Stribling is progressing toward hitting that goal. Once Stribling progresses to full-team drills, his timeline will get more dialed in. The 49ers have two more games in November, leaving the Week 13 matchup against the Giants as his earliest potential return date.

injury.comment: Aiyuk's agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said Tuesday that the receiver is "100 percent healthy" and fully recovered from his November 2024 right knee surgery and plans to work out for interested teams once he's released by the 49ers, Dianna Russini of BetUS TV reports.
injury.longComment: After Aiyuk filed his paperwork for reinstatement, San Francisco activated him from the reserve/left squad list Nov. 9. Rosenhaus noted that Aiyuk passed his physical at that time, with MRIs and X-rays on his surgically repaired knee revealing no concerns. The 49ers were granted a two-week roster exemption for Aiyuk that will expire next Monday, and the 28-year-old wideout is expected to be cut loose at that time since San Francisco seemingly hasn't expressed interested in retaining him. While it's unclear what kind of market might exist for Aiyuk's services coming off a lengthy layoff from NFL action, NFL reporter Jordan Schultz relayed earlier this month that at least one NFC team has expressed interest in adding the receiver to its practice squad.

injury.comment: Knee
Biceps
Guerendo (pectoral) was working off to the side during practice Thursday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.
injury.longComment: Guerendo has been on the PUP list with a pec injury since training camp, but it now looks like he may be making some progress toward returning to action. Even if he does get back to full strength at some point soon, though, it's not clear how much room there will be for him in a 49ers' backfield that has recently been dominated by veteran Christian McCaffrey and rookie third-rounder Kaelon Black.
